items.title: Standard Chartered sees more pain after $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin lower
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

items.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

items.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
items.summary: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

items.title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
items.summary: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.

items.title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
items.summary: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.
